purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 373 Fez (city code 4424); source registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
primaryPublisher: Agence Nationale de la Conservation Foncière, du Cadastre et de la Cartographie (ANCFCC)
registryBasis: Morocco’s ANCFCC lists separate Fès Medina and Fès Zouagha My Yacoub land-conservation and cadastre offices, confirming local cadastral coverage in Fez. Its cadastral-plan ordering service requires personal/organization details, a land-title number, CAPTCHA and SMS verification; it is not an anonymous public feature service.

officialSources.observation: Official ANCFCC directory lists Fès Medina and Fès Zouagha My Yacoub conservation/cadastre offices with Fez locations.
ANCFCC states that it establishes and maintains the national cadastre and cadastral plans, and makes cadastral data available in digital or analog form.
Official cadastral-plan order form requests personal/organization information, title number, CAPTCHA and SMS verification. No form was submitted.
Arabic ANCFCC product page describes cadastral plans and map sheets as land-survey products.

accessReview.reason: The official plan service is per-title and requires identity and title fields plus CAPTCHA and SMS confirmation. Those gated fields were not entered; no anonymous full parcel geometry route was identified.
